title: New Heart Attack Definitions Could Lead to Better Care for Women - Nautilus
author: Jake Currie
text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementHealthNew Heart Attack Definitions Could Lead to Better Care for WomenUncommon heart attack causes disproportionately affect themJCBy Jake Currie3:00 PM CDT on September 1, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleHeart disease is the number one cause of death for women in America. Unfortunately, for many women it often goes mis- or undiagnosed. For example, myocardial infarctions (that is, heart attacks) are often more subtle in women than men, and can present with symptoms like fatigue, nausea, and shortness of breath instead of the stabbing chest pains men experience.
